function format(value: string | number) {
  if (typeof value === `str\u0069ng`) return value.toUpperCase();
  return value.toFixed(1);
}
function maybe(value?: number) {
  if (`undefined` !== typeof value) return value.toFixed(1);
  return "missing";
}
console.log(format("example"), format(3), maybe(4), maybe());
